PREP-A.instruction: Prepare Stream A: on a 12 mL final-volume basis, charge N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol: 1.512 mmol (0.126 M final); add methanol to 12 mL total. Convert mmol to weighed/dispensed amount using the verified reagent MW, assay, and density recorded at preparation. The 12 mL basis is only the minimum consumed at the final feed rate during 24 min of commissioning and initial collection. Before preparation, add measured feed-line displacement, pump/reservoir hold-up and any extra startup or collection allowance. For an added duration, add this stream's flow rate multiplied by the extra minutes. Scale every solute amount and final solvent volume by the same factor to retain concentrations and reagent ratios. Confirm sufficient reagent availability and container capacity; no dead-volume allowance or available stock has been assumed. Provide priming and shutdown solvent separately. This schedule assumes continuous feeding; a finite sample-loop injection requires a separately specified loading and collection schedule.
